G0.requires: protocol/schema/catalog/state hashes fixed before payload audit

G1.requires: all synthetic guard tests and source-knownAt/mapping/action evidence pass; no future admission

G9.requires: G0-G8 all pass and admitted Tier1 >=1; freeze code/config/catalog/artifacts; no promotion

recoveryRules.G1: Synthetic truncation/future-poison/negative control/determinism PASS plus verified source identity/knownAt. Fail closed independent of observed returns.
recoveryRules.G2: Existing thresholds retained: >=95% universe-day input admissibility, >=99% missing reasons resolved, >=300 symbols with nEff>=12 in each19-session window. Observed-row fraction is not completeness. Family availability recorded separately; no outcome filter.
recoveryRules.archive: Reuse old allowlisted extractor of57 dates and7 filenames. Header-only skips outside whitelist; no additional REPORT19/protected payload extraction/JSON parsing. Storage lifecycle is object retention, not security lifecycle.
recoveryRules.classification: Per dated master eligible code/session: PIT_UNUSABLE if daily absent, receipt invalid or malformed/conflicting input. Otherwise PIT_PARTIAL when raw source integrity permits retrospective families but historical version/identity unavailable; PIT_VERIFIED only if knownAt upper <= firstUse plus mapping and required family contracts. PARTIAL metricEligibility is retrospective diagnostics only, profileEligibleFamilies empty. All-classified partition ledger and per-code session ledger are authoritative; code is not securityId.
recoveryRules.corporateAction: Unadjusted within-session OHLC range and turnover are not retrospectively adjusted for corporate actions. Cross-session gap/overnight need full action ledger/announcement availability. ExRT/AdjFactor effective snapshot is partial, not full PIT action history. No adjusted price used.
recoveryRules.identity: Dated code and name hashes permit snapshot continuity diagnostics only. No identity merge, successor inference or stable identifier fabrication. Explicit effective mapping and knownAt required for profile; otherwise UNKNOWN_IDENTITY_PERIOD.
recoveryRules.knownAt: Exact payload availability upper bound is saved acquisition receipt time bound to original bytes; event end is causal earliest lower bound for realized bars only, master lower bound UNKNOWN. Scheduled updates are context, never certification. Upper bound must be <= firstUse. Never retrodate receipt. No acquisition today.
recoveryRules.missingMinute: Official omitted-no-execution convention is contextual, not sufficient to relabel UNKNOWN. Match daily versus all-minute volume/turnover as feed-consistency diagnostic only. Halt/special quote/status remain UNKNOWN unless explicit evidence; lunch/preclose classified OUTSIDE_SESSION for regular denominator. No filling.
recoveryRules.outputs: New immutable namespace only. No dictionary freeze/prospective unless G0-G9 PASS. If input fails finish requirements/tests/regression/CI/handoff and STOP. 29/30 omitted with explicit conditional-artifact reasons.
recoveryRules.recoveryLooks: One availability audit; deterministic regeneration not another look. No new intrinsic or strategy outcome look. Exposure history never downgraded.
recoveryRules.statistics: Prior eight definitions,19-session windows,EB/reliability thresholds unchanged. No return/trait values before G1/G2. Conditional continuation must implement prior fixed census if gate passes, never manufacture N/A from missing implementation.

statistics.CI: Bonferroni8,95%; no IID row inference; two-way clustered sensitivity
statistics.controlModel: one linear residualization fitted first19 only, no search
statistics.drift: EW20/60/250 plus bounded250; compare short20 to nonoverlap prior20; insufficient history => UNKNOWN; drift confidence only
statistics.normalEB: log-scale where catalog says log; prior equivalent20 observations; prior variance fitted first19 only; weight nEff/(nEff+20)
statistics.peer: fixed tertiles of log-vol/log-turnover/log-price from first19; min30 securities per cell otherwise overall first19 prior; no sector fallback search
statistics.rateEB: Beta prior mean peer first19 with strength20; posterior Beta-binomial; nEff by distinct session events
